description: Anyankole erworete itunga ŋulu ipu kotoma Ankole, ko ataparan ka Uganda, ŋiuwai ka Mbarara, akwap ka aituk ŋulu ejaasi ŋamuwaŋin ŋulu elwanak.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Ateso courses (#131) with low confidence in Ateso; needs a native-speaker review. Word and unit notes fall back to the English notes about the target language.

why.title: Akiro ka **Ankole ka aituk ŋulu ejaasi ŋamuwaŋin ŋulu elwanak.**
why.text: Anyankole erworete kotoma Mbarara, Bushenyi, Ntungamo ka Ibanda, ka epoloi Akiga ka Anyoro. Kisisianakin kanuka ekal, elosit, aswam, ka isuban ka ailip ka Ankole.

cards.title: Kanuka ekal
cards.text: Kirwor ka ikapolok ka ikaitotak kotoma Ankole.

cards.title: Kanuka ikalosak
cards.text: Kilosi kiŋaren Mbarara tetere Kabale ka Anyanza Bunyonyi.

cards.title: Kanuka ŋulu emina ajenun
cards.text: Kiriamu italia ka ŋakiro ŋulu ka aituk.

landing.audience: Itunga ŋulu erworete Ateso ŋulu ekiŋaren, ikalia ŋulu elomete Ankole, ka ikalosak ŋulu elosete ko ataparan ka Uganda.
landing.first: Ayakuno, aitodiaar ka ikarin, kau ekal, akimuj, ekeya, apak, ŋiboro, etogo ka ajokus ka akwaŋan, aitodolet ka aitodolet.

cast.emma: Ekaitoŋaon ŋesi esisianakini Anyankole kiŋaren elosit
